title: Receive expected sample
purpose: Record actual receipt for one expected sample after accepting its client submission into intake.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Custodians and project managers can review submissions and receive samples. Admins inherit these operational roles. Client accounts cannot use staff intake pages.

sections.title: Eligibility and prefilled information
paragraphs: Requires an Accepted submission with a linked intake order. An already received sample redirects to its actual sample page. The header identifies the chain of custody, client/project, a Rush marker when the order is Rush, and count already received. Any project standing instructions and the order’s special instructions (carried over from the submission’s instructions when it was accepted) are shown above the form.

Client sample ID, sample type, matrix, sample source, collection type/times, collector, location, Sample remarks (from the client’s field notes), active matching intended tests and container type/preservative are prefilled from the current declaration. Quantities expand into individual container rows, up to 20. Retired or mismatched tests are omitted from prefill. Check every value against labels and paperwork. The field notes are also shown in the note above the form.

Actual collection time is required even when the client left it blank while planning bottles. Receipt time, cooler temperature, seals, condition, preservation check and custody must be recorded from the actual shipment. Times use the laboratory time zone. No receipt observations are supplied from client claims.

items.label: Client sample ID
items.description: Required client identifier, up to 120 characters; verify against the labels.

items.label: Sample type
items.description: List: Field sample (unless the client declared another), Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank. Prefilled from the declaration; set it from the chain of custody.

items.label: Collection type
items.description: Required Grab or Composite, prefilled from the declaration.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Required Water, Wastewater or Soil; determines eligible tests.

items.label: Sample source
items.description: Optional list grouped by matrix, prefilled from the declaration; Not recorded when none. It must belong to the matrix, otherwise the form refuses it.

items.label: Collector name
items.description: Required collector identity, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Composite started at
items.description: Optional for grab; composites require start and end, with start not after the end.

items.label: Collected / composite ended at
items.description: Required actual collection or composite-end timestamp. Must be no later than receipt.

items.label: Collection location
items.description: Required specific collection place, up to 200 characters.

items.label: Sample remarks
items.description: Optional multi-line text, prefilled from the client’s field notes. Edit it to what is noted on the chain of custody.

items.label: Received at
items.description: Required actual receipt time; cannot precede collection or be in the future.

items.label: Relinquished by
items.description: Required person handing over the shipment, up to 160 characters. Receiving staff identity is recorded from the signed-in user.

items.label: Cooler temperature (°C)
items.description: Required original reading in degrees Celsius, stored exactly with at most three decimal places and seven total digits. The entered text is preserved; do not round a reading to make it pass a limit. This is an observation, not a configured acceptance threshold.

items.label: Thermometer
items.description: Optional thermometer/instrument identifier, up to 160 characters. Free text with suggestions: in-service thermometers from the equipment register, then instruments typed on earlier receipts.

items.label: Coolant on arrival
items.description: Required list: Select…, Wet ice, Ice packs, Dry ice or None. Not taken from the client’s declaration.

items.label: Custody seal
items.description: Required list: Select…, Intact, Broken or damaged, No seal present or Other…. Other… reveals a text box whose text is stored, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Preservation check
items.description: Required list: Select…, Preservation verified at receipt, Preserved per labels, not verified, No chemical preservation required, Preserved by the laboratory at receipt, Preservation incorrect or missing, Not checked or Other…, up to 200 characters; distinct from the declared preservative on a container. The lists are starter vocabularies, not method requirements.

items.label: Storage location
items.description: Required initial laboratory location, up to 160 characters; becomes the receipt custody destination. Free text with suggestions from locations already recorded on samples.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Required one or more active definitions on active methods matching the sample matrix. Choices identify analyte, method/version, analytical unit and matrix. Confirm requests; intended client tests do not bind the receiver automatically.

items.label: Search analyte, method or unit
items.description: The enhanced picker searches analyte, method code/version and unit, with no result cap. Only tests for the selected matrix can be added. Enter adds the highlighted test; Backspace removes the last selected test and Left arrow moves to earlier selections.

items.label: Remove test / Remove this test / Remove these tests
items.description: Remove individual tests or the highlighted matrix-mismatched group. Changing matrix keeps existing choices for review; mismatches block saving until removed or the matrix is corrected. Without enhancement, use the native multiple-select.

items.label: Discrepancy
items.description: Optional description of differences or problems found at receipt. Any discrepancy requires a disposition note.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Proceed by default, Qualify, Hold or Reject. Records the receiving decision; does not erase observations or declare method compliance.

items.label: Disposition note
items.description: Required for any discrepancy or any disposition other than Proceed; explain the decision.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Required for each physical container, prefilled from the declaration. List: Select…, ten common vial, bottle and jar types (for example 40 mL VOA vial, 1 L plastic (HDPE), 1 L amber glass, 8 oz glass jar) or Other…, up to 160 characters; verify it.

items.label: Preservative
items.description: Optional list, Not recorded first: None, HNO3 (nitric acid), H2SO4 (sulfuric acid), HCl (hydrochloric acid), NaOH (sodium hydroxide), Zinc acetate + NaOH, Na2S2O3 (sodium thiosulfate), NaHSO4 (sodium bisulfate), Methanol, Ascorbic acid or Other…, up to 200 characters; prefilled from the declaration, so verify it.

items.label: Condition at receipt
items.description: Required observed physical condition for each container. List: Select…, Intact, Leaking, Broken or cracked, Lid loose, Headspace or bubbles, Insufficient volume, Label missing or illegible or Other…, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Remove this container
items.description: Exclude this row from receipt.

items.label: Add container
items.description: Append a physical-container row with JavaScript. Between 1 and 20 complete rows are required; blank rows are ignored. Each gets its own lab container label on save.

items.label: Receive sample
items.description: Create the actual sample with a laboratory accession ID, its containers, requested tests and initial custody/audit events, and link it to this expected sample. Return to submission detail. The signed-in user is the receiver. Active client/project, an uncancelled order and current order revision are rechecked. Concurrent receipt of the same expected sample cannot create two samples.

items.label: Cancel / submission number / Client submissions
items.description: Leave without receiving and return to the related submission or queue.

items.label: Required fields and errors
items.description: Asterisks mark required fields. Errors appear beside fields or above the form; entered values stay available for correction after validation fails. A stale-record error requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: When this form opens in a dialog, change its size without saving. Small screens already use the full screen.

items.label: Close form / Cancel
items.description: Leave without saving. If the dialog detects edits, Keep editing returns to the form and Discard changes leaves without saving.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Retry if loading the dialog failed. During saving, wait for the request to finish; the submit button indicates work is running.
